tools.name: creator_search
tools.description: Search YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram creators by topic keywords or one creator name/handle, with optional exclusions and SaaS hide filters. Results contain entitled filter values and SaaS list fields; TikTok live overviews require explicit creator_profile detail=true, include_shop=true. Search never fetches details or returns cumulative/product GMV snapshots or contact addresses. The returned item.id is an opaque creator ID for creator_profile and must never be copied into Campaign2 targets[].channelId; Campaign2 requires the raw platform channel_id. YouTube avg_views stays overall; average-view bounds use avg_views_shorts for video_type=1, avg_views_normal for video_type=2, and avg_views otherwise. These are search-index snapshots, not profile-detail samples; missing classified values stay null.

tools.name: campaign2_invitations_state
tools.description: Change invitation state. Bulk cancel waiting or queued invitations in ONE request with targets (1-1000 creators), or all_matching plus expected_count and optional min_sub/max_sub/regions filters. For queued cancellation set status_group=queued: creators already sent, sending, uncertain, replied or otherwise changed are skipped; other cancellable creators continue. Report data.cancelledCount and data.skippedCount, including zero cancellations. Waiting is the default strict scope. Never loop single-creator cancellation for a batch. Choose exactly one scope: target, task_id, targets, all_matching. Batch scopes only support action=cancel; status_group is only valid with targets or all_matching. All-matching queued counts may shrink but must not grow beyond expected_count.
